Commander, with the defense system down, the zombies are making their way through the city to your location. Reactivating them will take some time before everything is fully operational.
Understood. Recruit, you heard her! Set up our defenses and prepare for the horde! Everyone else, hold position!
Alright! Now we're talking! Hopefully they'll let me stay in the city after we save their skin. They're uh—... not all that happy with me right now.
What? Can't they have a little sun? It's his fault for not looking.
I hope V's right about the tunnels. If the system comes up before Hops and Demo make it out, they'll be stuck with those things. Hah — but I know they'd collapse the entire mine if they could.
The best we can do is take out as many zombies as we can. That way they only have to worry about what's behind them.
Ugh! The southern core isn't powering up! This system was built before I was palced on the project, so they're using some seriously old tech. This was never designed to be turned off in sections.
Something must have chewed through the wiring on its way in. I'm heading there now with a repair crew. Let's cross our fingers it's something fixable.
They seriously didn't have a backup plan for a situation like this? You've got to be kidding me!
It's not that. From what I've heard in headquarters, manufacturing plants are being overrun with infected and— Get off me! Arg... I doubt Cyber City can get the materials to even build a backup plan.
Hey zombie, catch! Yeah! Haha! Come here! Watch out for Mr. Nibbles!
... Mr. Nibbles? You name your traps?
Hah, wait until you hear about Betsy—... I LEFT BETSY INSIDE THE MINE.
Commander, come in. I heard from V that you've made it into the city. There's something heading your way that's— and destroying the radio towers.
It broke through the gates of the city. They're already moving the citizens further back into the bunkers.
Agh! You stupid thing! There! The crystal core is back online. The zombie who bit the wire is fried to a crisp.
It will have to spin up before we can turn on the system. Hold on, Commander, we're almost there.
We're running out of time over here! That thing's getting close!
It's got to be a few blocks away. Minigunner, cover the survivors and get them inside the building!
We can't keep going like this! I'm almost out of ammo!
V we need those guns up! What's taking so long?!
Almost there! A few more minutes!
Oh, I'm down to my last traps... What a horrible day...
Yes! Systems are coming online! Everything's booting up! We've almost got it!
It's too late! It's already here!
Focus everything we get on the Grave Digger! We're getting out of this!
